execution.data_policy: Generate each dataset once from the specification, save its float64 bytes and SHA256, and require every sampler subprocess to load the same bytes.
execution.prior_predictive_policy: Generate one shared prior-predictive check per scenario after asserting that blackbox and analytical models resolve identical priors.
execution.trace_policy: Save each returned DataTree to NetCDF immediately after sampling and before summaries or posterior prediction; record the file SHA256 and byte count in the compact result.
execution.timing_policy: Use perf_counter. Report compile and first-evaluation fields separately; sampling_call includes any sampler-internal compilation that cannot be isolated without changing the fitted computation.
